title: Intentional Programming demo (Part 1) - Editor
summary: A roughly ten-minute demo of Microsoft's Intentional Programming research system, showing its editor and an unusual way of working with code. It is the first of two clips cut from a longer video.
why: Commenters cite it as an early example of projectional or intent-based programming tools when discussing alternatives to text-based code.

quote.text: Here are a couple of demo vids from well over 10 years ago
